notes_zh:
### Beta 测试通道

- **新增** 「参与 Beta 测试」开关（设置 → 关于 → 自动检查更新下方）。开启后会自动检查并接收 Beta 版本，提前体验下一个大版本的新功能；Beta 稳定后会自动升级到正式版
- **新增** Beta 版本独立下载入口：[www.lifedever.com/PasteMemo/beta](https://www.lifedever.com/PasteMemo/beta)（首页下载区下方也有"试用 Beta 版本 →"链接）

### 更新检查

- **修复** 版本号比较在遇到 SemVer pre-release 标识（如 `-beta.N`）时判断错误的问题。旧版本会把 `1.7.0-beta.1` 误判为高于 `1.7.0` 正式版，导致 Beta 用户无法升级到正式版
- **改进** Beta 版的更新提示弹窗与正式版有清晰的视觉区分（橙色 BETA 标签 + 风险提示）
- **改进** 后备更新源（GitHub / Gitee Releases API）现在会过滤掉预发布版本，避免极少数情况下被误推送 Beta 版本

notes_en:
### Beta Testing Channel

- **New** "Join Beta Channel" toggle (Settings → About, below the auto-update controls). Opt in to automatically check for and receive beta builds, and try new features before they reach the stable channel. When a beta is promoted to stable, you'll be auto-upgraded
- **New** Dedicated beta download page at [www.lifedever.com/PasteMemo/beta](https://www.lifedever.com/PasteMemo/beta) (also linked from the homepage's download section)

### Update Checking

- **Fix** Version comparison incorrectly handled SemVer pre-release identifiers (e.g. `-beta.N`). Older builds would rank `1.7.0-beta.1` above `1.7.0` stable, blocking beta users from upgrading to the stable release
- **Improve** Beta update prompts now look visually distinct from stable ones (orange BETA tag + risk warning banner)
- **Improve** Fallback update sources (GitHub / Gitee Releases API) now filter out pre-releases, preventing the rare case of a beta being suggested to a stable user

beta.notes_zh:
- **新增** 列表行显示 AI Agent 来源徽标，多个格式徽章高度对齐
- **改进** 顶部菜单「文件 → 导入数据」现在有独立的进度面板（解密 → 导入 → 刷新主界面 → 结果摘要），并把解密 / 解析放到后台线程，不再卡住主线程让光标转圈；导入完成的成功提示直接整合在面板里（"已导入 N 条 / 跳过 M 条 / 新增分组 K 个 / 新增规则 L 个"），不再额外弹一个 alert
- **改进** 设置面板的导入流程一致化：解密 / 刷新等无确定百分比的阶段显示滚动动画；导入结束前同步刷新所有打开的窗口，避免主窗口先空一段再"突然出现数据"
- **改进** 快捷面板的「AI Agent」过滤标签移到 tab 栏末尾
- **修复** 当历史保留期（设置 → Pro → 保留期）和「永久保存」分组同时使用时，分组内超过保留期的条目会从列表/快捷面板里"消失"，但实际还在数据库里。再次复制相同内容时会被静默并入这条隐藏老条目，导致用户感知为"这串字复制不上"
- **修复** 详情面板的文件大小现在跟随符号链接，显示链接指向的实际文件大小

⚠️ **这是 Beta 测试版本**。建议在非关键环境体验，问题反馈到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/lifedever/PasteMemo-app/issues)。Beta 稳定后会自动升级到正式版。

beta.notes_en:
- **New** Clip rows display an AI Agent source badge, with multi-badge heights aligned
- **Improve** Top-menu **File → Import** now uses a dedicated progress panel (decrypt → import → refresh main view → result summary). Decrypt + parse run off the main actor so the cursor no longer spins on large files. The success summary ("Imported N, skipped M, +K groups, +L rules") is folded into the same panel — no separate alert
- **Improve** Settings panel import gets the same polish: an indeterminate spinner during non-measurable stages, and a synchronous refresh pass before the sheet dismisses so the main window doesn't flash empty after a large import
- **Improve** Quick panel's "AI Agent" filter tab moved to the end of the tab bar
- **Fix** When a retention period (Settings → Pro → Retention) is configured alongside a "preserve items" group, items in that group would silently disappear from the list / quick panel once they aged past the cutoff — yet still live in the database and still win duplicate detection. The next copy of the same content silently merged into the hidden row, so the user saw nothing happen and assumed "this string won't copy"
- **Fix** File size in the detail panel now follows symlinks, showing the actual target file's size instead of the link's

⚠️ **This is a beta release.** Please test on non-critical machines and report issues on [GitHub](https://github.com/lifedever/PasteMemo-app/issues). You'll be auto-upgraded to the stable release once the beta stabilizes.
